title: Ten in the Bed
transcription:
Ten in the Bed

There were ten in the bed, and the
little one said: "Roll over, Roll over,"
So they all rolled over and one fell out,
and hit the floor and gave a shout!
Please remember to tie a knot in your pajamas,
single beds were only made for.

(count from ten to one, beginning the verse
over with nine instead of ten in the bed, and
continue left until there is only one)

...one in the bed, and little one said:
"I'm lonely!"
